concerns.text: FR-001 references “(See US-1)” but no identifier US-1 is defined anywhere in the document. The same issue appears for US-2 and US-3 in FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-006, and FR-007, creating unresolved cross‑references and unstable terminology (User Story vs US). Define US‑1/US‑2/US‑3 or replace the references with the existing “User Story 1/2/3” identifiers.
